name: Checkbox
description: SEED contract for the CARBON round — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Subject: @carbon/react@1.112.0 + @carbon/styles@1.111.0 (pinned, examples/carbon/PROVENANCE.md). TRI-STATE ON ONE AXIS (the MUI Checkbox precedent): Carbon spells it as two independent booleans (`checked` + `indeterminate`); the axis value expands into both library props through the $props grammar so the per-value glyph promotion stays single-axis.
